sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Retain the valid quantity-node encodings, violation-oriented corrosion query, non-mandatory materialApprovalStatus evidenceState range, and the direct-calculation f2 tolerance. Repair the yield-strength alternatives: the current query only handles enumerated B/D/E and AH/DH/EH/FH grades, omits the canonical normalStrengthHullStructuralSteel and highStrengthHullStructuralSteel category representations, and does not faithfully encode the conditional provision allowing an actually accepted different steel grade to use its substituted yield stress. Add a semantically constrained accepted-different-grade branch rather than a presence-only unconstrained fallback, without making normal- and high-strength alternatives conjunctively mandatory.
